_note: Digging on the street map (ui/innerMapDigging.js): holes, filling them in, graves. Seconds are real seconds of work at the spot; carrying a set of tools (any item id in 'tools') multiplies them by toolSpeed. 'finds' are rolled once per hole, in order: the first whose chance hits is found.

finds.text: Your spade turns up {gold} gold coins, buried long ago.
You turn up a broken clay pot. Nothing of worth.
An old bone, brown with age. Best not to wonder whose.

text.dig: You dig a hole, the spoil heaped beside it.
text.fill: You shovel the earth back in and tread it down.
text.bury: You lay {name} in the hole and heap the earth over them.
text.exhume: You dig {name} back up out of the grave.
respects: You stand a while by {name}'s grave.
You bow your head over {name}'s grave.
